task: Country border: light grey outside the arena and a yellow neon edge line, same look in the three biomes

design.shared_code: PIO_ArenaFrame(inside, sd, pix, time) in Assets/Resources/Shaders/CountryDistance.hlsl (already included by the three composites); called from the ground shading of LiquidComposite (PIO_Ground), FireComposite (ground branch) and ElectricComposite (PIOE_Ground). Same function for country polygons and the classic rounded square (it takes the arena signed distance).
design.fetch_cost: none added: the glow is derived from the arena signed distance already computed for the ground (analytic square or the existing _PIO_CountryDistance fetch). No derivative inside, usable in the existing dynamic branches.
design.layering: drawn in the ground layer only, so territories, trails, heads and pockets are composited on top of it; the line is centred 0.04 u outside the edge so a territory hugging the rim does not cover its core.

parameters.outside_grey_srgb: #B4B9C1 (Palette.OutsideArena, used by all three themes; also the camera clear color)
parameters.glow: lerp toward the glow color by saturate((0.60 * exp(-x / 0.09) + 0.32 * exp(-x / 0.30)) * pulse), x = |sd - 0.04| in world units
parameters.pulse: 1 + 0.07 * sin(1.4 t) on the halo only (period about 4.5 s), the core is steady
parameters.max_value: all components <= 1.0, so nothing feeds the High-tier bloom (threshold 1.1)
parameters.inner_rim_shadow: kept as before in each biome (darkens the ground inside the edge, so the neon reads)

files_changed: Assets/Resources/Shaders/LiquidComposite.hlsl (PIO_Ground uses the frame, takes time; header comment)
Assets/Resources/Shaders/ElectricComposite.hlsl (PIOE_Ground uses the frame instead of the cool blue rim line and dark outside; header comment)
